description: Second-tier riser that lifts a pedal a step above the board while keeping it clipped in. The base is the measured 125B mount outline reduced to a solid.

base.source: measured 125B OEM mount mesh, inherited via enclosure_125b

clips.source: measured 125B OEM mount mesh, inherited via enclosure_125b

open_questions: Riser body, front lip, grommets and tilt are not modelled; only the flat base exists.
Mount holes are deliberately absent from the base; pedal attachment belongs to a later feature.
notes: The riser's resting surface is the plate's own underside, so the base must stay identical to the 125B mount outline rather than being redrawn.
